title: El castillo: cómo se entra, cómo se genera y cómo cambia
description: docs/castle.md. The castle's way from the school door to the throne: the guards before the curtain, the curtain parted for good (cortina) and its stair up to the generated first floor, the floor whole and its rooms, another day's floor, the gym shut until Aurelià, and the castle after each boss. Run it with --gpu.

steps.caption: Trinitat Vella: el castillo ha crecido sobre la escuela Rec Comtal. La Pompa ocupa la puerta; entrar es «Entrar en la escuela».
